responsibilities: Own the BI Layer: Serve as the primary administrator for our Metabase instance. You will build comprehensive dashboards, configure native SQL queries into reusable Metabase Models, and set up field filters for non-technical users.
Advanced Data Modeling: Write complex, performant SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, JSONB extraction) in PostgreSQL and MySQL to transform raw application data into clean reporting tables.

Query Optimization: Ensure our databases stay fast and healthy. You will use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to identify bottlenecks, suggest indexing strategies, and write queries that don't lock up production environments.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the translation layer between our software engineering team and business stakeholders. When engineering ships a new feature, you will be right there to map the new tables and expose the data in Metabase.
Data Governance: Manage SSO, user permissions, and data dictionaries to ensure the right people have access to the right data securely.
